query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_festas,
  SUM(valorTotal) as faturamento_total,
  SUM(valorPago) as valor_recebido,
  SUM(valorTotal - valorPago) as valor_a_receber,
  ROUND(AVG(valorTotal), 2) as ticket_medio
FROM festas
WHERE dataFesta >= '2024-12-01' AND dataFesta <= '2025-11-30';
